observation.visible_scene: A stationary indoor scene on a tiled floor: a clear glass lamp bulb mounted in a white cylindrical socket glows with an intense blue-white arc, producing a strong diagonal rainbow lens-flare and a greenish-cyan ambient cast over everything. To the left sits a white rectangular box (ballast/power unit) linked to the socket by thin wires, with a white cable looping across the floor. Behind is a white cabinet/dresser with two metallic bow-tie handles and small items on top. The framing is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: The lamp stays continuously lit across the whole excerpt: the bright core, the surrounding blue glow, and the diagonal flare streak are present and steady in every frame, with no visible onset or offset.
No object motion is detectable; the bulb, socket, ballast box, wires, cabinet handles and top items keep the same pixel positions from the first to the last frame.
No camera motion (pan/zoom/tilt) is evident; the background geometry remains unchanged.
The greenish-cyan color cast and the small vertical blue streak near the cabinet base persist without observable variation, indicating a static interval.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the lamp was switched on or off outside this segment, and any flicker or intensity change occurring between the sampled frames.
The purpose of the setup (test, display, etc.) and what happens before or after the crop.
uncertain_details: Any very subtle brightness flicker or flare movement, if present, is below the resolution of the sampled frames and cannot be confirmed.
The exact lamp type and the identity of the white box are not verifiable from the images alone.
